props.title: Your system wants softness before sleep
props.summary: The main pattern is overstimulation and mental carryover from the day, so the right crystal should calm the nervous system before it tries to energize anything else.
highlights: Too much mental charge at night
Best matched to gentle, repeatable support
props.disclaimer: For wellness and self-reflection purposes only.

props.reason: Amethyst is the cleanest first recommendation when the goal is calmer evenings and easier sleep onset.
props.note: Keep it on the nightstand and pair it with three slow breaths.

props.title: How to use it tonight
steps: Place the crystal beside your bed before sunset if possible.
Hold it for three breaths and set one calming intention.
Repeat the same ritual for three nights before switching stones.
props.closing: If the heaviness feels more emotional than mental, the next turn can compare amethyst with rose quartz.
